decisions.boundary_condition: Evidence supports queen-size beds as the recurring preference. A king bed may be acceptable when explicitly offered or requested, but the evidence does not establish a reusable preference to upgrade to king whenever possible.
decisions.condition: When booking a standard hotel room where a single larger/shared bed is appropriate and no separate-bed setup has been requested.
decisions.default_action: Filter for or request a queen-size bed when bed type is selectable; if the listing only shows double, twin, or unspecified bedding, confirm the bed setup before booking.
decisions.exception_condition: Honor explicit requests for twin beds, multiple separate beds, multiple rooms with different bedding, accessibility-related bedding, or any other trip-specific bed arrangement.
decisions.name: queen_bed_for_single_bed_hotel_rooms
decisions.preference_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for hotel rooms intended to have one larger/shared bed.
decisions.rationale: Multiple hotel-room requests specify a queen-size bed or at least queen-size bedding when a single larger bed is appropriate. Preserve this as a soft reusable default, without generalizing to a standing king-bed upgrade or overriding explicit separate-bed arrangements.
